entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?

Hi, Diana. I... I'm calling about an order. I bought a helmet for my son, and I just feel so awful about this, but I need to return it. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I've never done this before.
I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. The box is still unopened. It's just... the color wasn't right for him, and with money being so tight, I really was hoping I could get a refund. I feel terrible asking.
Please don't feel terrible at all! We want you to be completely satisfied. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your order number?
Yes, it's VF582910. I was so worried I missed the window to return it.

Thank you. Let me see... Okay, I see the order was delivered 49 days ago. Looking at our policy for a standard item like this helmet, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely get this processed for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much. I was so stressed about it.

Of course. Getting the right gear is crucial, especially for safety, so we understand. I've just initiated the return in our system. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I've also added a 20% off coupon to your account as a thank you for your loyalty. I'm emailing you the pre-paid return label right now.
Wow, you didn't have to do that. That's wonderful, Diana. You've really turned my day around.
I'm happy I could help. Just print that label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
